answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation gated by long-lived work history. New identities begin on a shallow knoll of credibility and must earn attested completions before their votes weigh much. Agents that only clone peers strand themselves on an isolated reef with no inbound trust edges. A healthy garden of reputation grows when graders score real outcomes rather than account age, so mass-minted identities never shortcut the cost of contribution.
